name: Theme Switcher by User
description: Lets each user select their own theme.
project_description:
The Theme Switcher By User module is an tool designed to enhance user experience by providing a seamless and dynamic way to switch between themes. This module introduces a user-friendly block, allowing users to easily transition between different visual styles of your site. Whether it's for accessibility, personal preference, or just a change of scenery, the Theme Switcher module makes it possible with just a few clicks. Available themes can be easily configured both for a specific user and for everyone.

 Features 
 Dynamic Theme Selection : Users can choose from a list of available themes. These themes can be set globally or be entity-specific, offering flexibility and control over the visual presentation.

 Configuration of available themes : Available themes can be easily configured both for a specific user and for everyone.

 Persistent Selection : User's theme choices are recorded in the 'select theme' entity, ensuring their preferences are remembered during subsequent visits.

 Configuring excluded pages : It can be easily configured so that the selected theme doesn't work on some pages, but the default or the user's theme specified in the route.
